name: Coordinated Charge [Combat, Selfish, Teamwork]
body:
You are an expert at leading your allies into the fray.

Prerequisite(s): You have at least two other teamwork feats, base attack bonus +10.

Benefit(s): When an ally charges a creature that is no further away from you than your base speed, you can, as an immediate action, also charge that creature. You must be able to follow all of the normal charge rules.
